scope: Single-entry quality review of Metaview. Verified the active AI recruiting platform, interview-notes workflow, current Notes pricing, integrations and recent botless recording update; refined the existing catalog entry without changing lifecycle status.

accepted.name: Metaview
accepted.description: AI recruiting platform that captures and transcribes interviews, creates structured notes, candidate summaries and scorecards, and connects interview intelligence with ATS workflows; its broader agent suite also supports sourcing, application review, screening and reporting.
accepted.userValue: For recruiting teams that need consistent interview documentation and faster candidate workflows across calls and ATS records. The Notes plan is free for 25 calls per month per user or $60 per user per month for unlimited calls; other agents have separate limits and pricing. Review AI-generated assessments with human judgment and configure candidate consent, opt-out and retention to meet local rules.

notes: Metaview is an active recruiting platform spanning sourcing, application review, screening, interview notes and reporting; its interview-notes product captures calls and in-person conversations, produces structured notes and candidate summaries, and syncs scorecards and notes with ATS systems.

The official Notes pricing page lists a free plan with 25 calls per user per month and a Pro plan at $60 per user per month for unlimited calls. Other agents have their own limits and pricing, so the Notes price must not be generalized to the whole platform.
The October 12, 2026 product update documents desktop-based botless note-taking and automatic redaction of sensitive information.

Because the product processes candidate conversations and assists candidate assessment, teams should review AI-generated outputs, obtain and manage appropriate consent, and configure opt-out and retention settings for applicable jurisdictions.
